## Why Take This Course?

Modern statistics runs on computation. This course develops the **algorithmic thinking** needed for:

- Building simulation-based inference methods
- Working with latent variable models and missing data
- High-dimensional data analysis
- Reproducible, scalable statistical computing

You'll learn *why* methods work, *how* to implement them efficiently, and *when* to apply them to real problems.

## What You'll Learn

::: {.feature-grid}

::: {.feature-card}
### Computational Foundations
Monte Carlo methods, numerical integration, simulation design, and algorithmic thinking for statistical problems.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Statistical Inference Tools
EM algorithm, bootstrap, importance sampling, optimization techniques, and Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC).
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Research Practice
Independent project design, reproducible analysis, performance evaluation, and professional communication of results.
:::

:::
